provenance_policy.acquisition: A publication date, URL directory, archive timestamp or file mtime is not an acquisition record. acquired_date is null unless backed by a logged download.
provenance_policy.licenses: Component notices do not establish a license for an entire SDK, SVD, manual or derived text. No vendor raw/derived inputs are approved for source distribution.
provenance_policy.historical_sources: Current means the selected project pin, not a claim that no newer vendor source exists. Superseded pins remain distinguishable by path, hash and printed revision.
provenance_policy.generator_commit: The project is an uncommitted source snapshot; a local generator Git commit is unknown. reference-index.json includes a reproducible file-hash manifest instead of an invented commit.

provenance_policy.source_layout: sources/evidence-sources.json is the sole authored external URL/hash/member authority. Vendor originals and extracted bytes live in ignored sources/vendor/. Provenance compatibility views are generated under build/provenance/ and are not source-bundle inputs.
